problem_statement: A neutral, accessible, responsive editorial content publishing website with article listing, category filtering, search, individual article pages, reading time estimation, author profiles, related articles, JSON-LD structured data, sitemap, and zero tracking.

target_user.context_of_use: Fast-paced daily workflow requiring instant, friction-free outcomes

pain_points: Current market alternatives are either overly bloated, slow, or enforce steep subscription paywalls.
Lack of streamlined, zero-friction, mobile-responsive workflows for daily operational tasks.

urgency_evaluation.status_quo_failure: Existing workarounds either violate security compliance or waste significant manual time.

root_cause_analysis: Legacy tools monetize user data or rely on costly server compute, forcing an architectural mismatch between user privacy/speed needs and vendor profit models.
constraints: Zero unnecessary dependencies: Keep client bundle lean and runtime responsive.
Mobile-first responsive architecture: Must function seamlessly on all viewport sizes.
Accessibility: Semantic HTML5 with WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard navigation.
desired_outcomes_and_success_criteria: Immediate task completion within 3 clicks or drag-and-drop actions.
Lighthouse performance score >= 90 across Mobile and Desktop.
